pages.text: Hold $(thing)Shift$() with a fully drawn bow to enter rapid fire mode, automatically releasing a stream of arrows at high speed. Each arrow costs a small amount of soul energy.$(br2)Each individual arrow deals fixed damage, but the sheer fire rate — combined with the bow's ability to ignore invincibility frames — makes this skill extremely potent against single targets.

pages.title: Unlocking
pages.text: Place the Soul Bow in a crafting table with an $(item)Arrow$() and a $(item)Crossbow$() to begin the forging task.$(br2)This task demands fast, sustained damage output within a tight time window. Check the tooltip for requirements.
